mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are those organs whose similarity is due to their sharing a common ancestral structure."
Homologous structures in different species are those organs whose similarity is due to their sharing a common ancestral structure.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is derived from the IMZS cells that form the lining of the archenteron roof and from the subblastoporal vegetal cells that become the archenteron floor."
The endoderm is derived from the IMZS cells that form the lining of the archenteron roof and from the subblastoporal vegetal cells that become the archenteron floor.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a morphological term used to describe the reserve food in the oocyte, formed of proteins, neutral fats, phospholipids, carbohydrates and glycogen."
Yolk is a morphological term used to describe the reserve food in the oocyte, formed of proteins, neutral fats, phospholipids, carbohydrates and glycogen.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a small T-shaped device like the IUD and is placed inside the uterus by a doctor."
Intrauterine System or IUS (Mirena) - The IUS is a small T-shaped device like the IUD and is placed inside the uterus by a doctor.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an extraembryonic tissue that produces blood cells similar to the structure that surrounds the yolk in birds."
The yolk sac is an extraembryonic tissue that produces blood cells similar to the structure that surrounds the yolk in birds.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are called pronuclei and the resulting diploid cell is called a zygote."
The fusing nuclei are called pronuclei and the resulting diploid cell is called a zygote.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an extracellular layer often used in sperm recognition."
Surrounding the egg plasma membrane is an extracellular layer often used in sperm recognition.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a bit different than in the other embryos we have studied, but neurulation is essentially the same in all vertebrate embryos so is like that seen in the frog."
Gastrulation is a bit different than in the other embryos we have studied, but neurulation is essentially the same in all vertebrate embryos so is like that seen in the frog.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the basic unit of the dorsal mesoderm, but it is thought that the dorsal portion of the somites may also have similar properties."
The notochord is the basic unit of the dorsal mesoderm, but it is thought that the dorsal portion of the somites may also have similar properties.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the functional equivalent of the dorsal lip of the amphibian blastopore (i.e., the organizer) and the fish embryonic shield."
node is the functional equivalent of the dorsal lip of the amphibian blastopore (i.e., the organizer) and the fish embryonic shield.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the union of a human egg and sperm, usually occurring in the ampulla of the fallopian tube."
Human fertilization is the union of a human egg and sperm, usually occurring in the ampulla of the fallopian tube.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the formation embryo through different processes of development; for example, gametogenesis, fertilization, cleavage formation,blastula, gastrulation, and organogenesis."
Embryology is the formation embryo through different processes of development; for example, gametogenesis, fertilization, cleavage formation,blastula, gastrulation, and organogenesis.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a good option for women who can't take estrogen, are over 35, or have a risk of blood clots."
The mini-pill is a good option for women who can't take estrogen, are over 35, or have a risk of blood clots.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means that she do not have sex on the days that she may be fertile."
Periodic abstinence means that she do not have sex on the days that she may be fertile.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a skin patch worn on the lower abdomen, buttocks, or upper body."
The Patch (Ortho Evra) -This is a skin patch worn on the lower abdomen, buttocks, or upper body.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the vitelline envelope, which forms a fibrous mat around the egg."
Outside the plasma membrane is the vitelline envelope, which forms a fibrous mat around the egg.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an ectodermal organ formed through induction by mesodermal cells."
The shell gland is an ectodermal organ formed through induction by mesodermal cells.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the process of formation of gametes from the germ cells in the testes and ovaries."
Gametogenesis is the process of formation of gametes from the germ cells in the testes and ovaries.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used to thread a tiny spring-like device through the vagina and uterus into each fallopian tube."
A thin tube is used to thread a tiny spring-like device through the vagina and uterus into each fallopian tube.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are called barrier methods of birth control because they put up a block, or barrier, which keeps the sperm from reaching the egg."
The Male Condom - Condoms are called barrier methods of birth control because they put up a block, or barrier, which keeps the sperm from reaching the egg.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a term that describes several different methods used to help infertile couples."
Assisted reproductive technology (ART) is a term that describes several different methods used to help infertile couples.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the next stage of development in animal after cleavage and blastula formation."
Gastrulation and invagination is the next stage of development in animal after cleavage and blastula formation.

IUI is known by most people as artificial insemination.

acrosome

yolk-rich pole

Cleavage

Placental abruption is the premature separation of a placenta from its implantation in the uterus.

cervical shield
The cervical shield is a silicone cup that has a one-way valve that creates suction and helps it fit against the cervix.

Between these folds is a shallow median groove, the neural groove.

Embryogenesis

major complication of IVF

Embryonic stem (ES) cells
Embryonic stem cells
ES

inner cell mass

blastula

Placenta previa is a condition in which the placenta is attached close to or covering the cervix.

mouse embryo proper
The mouse embryo proper is derived from the descendants of the inner cells of the 16-cell stage, supplemented by cells dividing from the trophoblast during the transition to the 32-cell stage.

Mitosis
Mitosis is the reproduction of skin, heart, stomach, cheek, hair etc. cells.
